{{Quote|The most beautiful parkland in the Republic--until the first bombs fell.|[[Jari Orez]] to [[The Barsen'thor]]|<ref name="Old Blood">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Old Blood|[[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]}}</ref>}}
'''Axial Park''' was a major point of interest at [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] that showcased [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian's]] appreciation for nature.

==Description==
Amongst the towering structures and high-speed trams, one was always able to find a small tree-lined park or a quiet reflection pool in [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia's]] Axial Park in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]]. This site marked the grandest expression of the [[Corellian/Legends|world's]] desire to remain connected to nature that differentiated it from the likes of other [[City/Legends|metropolises]] such as [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] and [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. As a result, Axial Park cost over seventy billion [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]], and Coronet City's civil engineers set aside valuable real estate for the creation of several museums along with landmarks that were separated by beautiful parklands.<ref name="TORC">{{TORcite|type=codex|Axial Park}}</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|I've got a platoon of combat-starved grunts due in Axial Park days ago. What'm I supposed to do with them now?''"<br />"''Calisthenics?''"<br />"''Don't get smart with me.|Conversation between a frustrated Imperial lieutenant and his subordinate|<ref name="Ambient">{{TORcite|type=location|[[Incorporation Islands Tram Station]]|[[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]}}, ambient dialogue</ref>}}
In the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Axial Park became one of the greatest tragedies of the conflict with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] when they despoiled the beauty of the land by bombardment. In addition, the park's grand museums became converted into bunkers as part of the struggle against the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]],<ref name="TORC" /> who invaded Corellia and deployed [[Platoon/Legends|platoons]] of [[Trooper/Legends|troops]] in the parkland.<ref name="Ambient" />
